boundary: zero model contacts: the only fakes are the gate and the transport (core.flight.runtime.WireCheckGate / WireCheckTransport, which never opens a socket). Any score below is computed over the transport's canned response and is not a measurement of anything.

dispatch.queue_depth: not a knob: one contact per sample means nothing queues behind a sample, and more in-flight requests than slots is what the slot pinning exists to forbid

cells.payload_to_wire_tools_mapping: payload tool_schemas -> request body 'tools' is core.model.transport.LlamaServerTransport's own step, covered by tests/unit/test_native_tools_arm.py's transport section; this check asserts at the transport seam, where the payload is what crosses

response_arrival.basis: rails.core_client.RequestTiming.native_tool_calls, set from core.model.CoreResponse.tool_calls; None means the response envelope carried no tool_calls key at all, i.e. the model answered as text
